notes: Send @unit_worker/villager.webp@to @resource/resource_food.webp@, rally @resource/rally.webp@ rally on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 3. First @unit_worker/villager.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@.
Rally @resource/rally.webp@ back on to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until enough resources to build @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@.
Build @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@ close to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ with 2 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@.
Transfer two additional @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, one to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@, the other to @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
The two @unit_worker/villager.webp@ building @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@ should be queued to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@.
Keep @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ until ready to go @age/age_3.webp@.
Build a @building_economy/house.webp@ with @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@.
Build another @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_military/barracks.webp@.

If the enemy is making units, skip @building_military/barracks.webp@and build a @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ , send 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to make a single trip to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ for @technology_defensive/arrow-slits.webp@.
Send  free @unit_lancaster/lord_lancaster.webp@ to defend @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or harass enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if possible.

Send 10 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@(9 @unit_worker/villager.webp@) and @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@) to build @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ to protect @resource/resource_gold.webp@ + @resource/boar.webp@ / @resource/deer.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@ if possible.
@resource/boar.webp@ > @resource/deer.webp@.

The @unit_worker/villager.webp@ building @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ should be queued to go to build @building_economy/mill.webp@ and harvest new @resource/deer.webp@/@resource/boar.webp@ or @resource/berrybush.webp@.
If not able to secure @resource/resource_food.webp@, you can be vulnerable to raids and risk running out of food.

Leave 4  @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@, sending one to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and the rest to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and rally @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until the end of the game.

Build more @unit_lancaster/lord_lancaster.webp@ from @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@ and send with the 3 free @unit_lancaster/elitechampion.webp@ from @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ to kill villager with ranged shot + harass.
Start producing @unit_lancaster/elitechampion.webp@ from @building_military/barracks.webp@ to keep harassing.
Wounded units can go to @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@ and restore HP
One @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ builds a house, then back to @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Research @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@@technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ @technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@
Another @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ builds a @building_religious/monastery.webp@ then back to @resource/resource_wood.webp@. @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@

Start producing @unit_religious/monk-3.webp@ to gather @resource/relics.webp@.  Send one @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ for @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ and @technology_military/wedge-rivets.webp@ + @technology_military/military-academy.webp@ + @technology_military/bloomery.webp@ @technology_military/decarbonization.webp@ + @technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@.

Send one @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build a @building_economy/house.webp@ and second @building_military/barracks.webp@ to produce more @unit_lancaster/elitechampion.webp@.

Start building @building_military/archery-range.webp@ to produce @unit_lancaster/yeoman_age2.webp@ to counter their @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@. Get some @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to build @building_lancaster/manor.webp@.  Research @technology_lancaster/condensed_land_practices.webp@@technology_lancaster/open_field_system.webp@ as needed.
